_readme: Hand corrections. 'endpoints' maps a project (DESC:<ProjectID without spaces> or GA:<TEAMS>) to the station names its line runs between, when the title alone is misleading. 'points' maps STATE:<normalized name> to a hand-sited coordinate; every entry must say why.

SC:v c summer.why: V.C. Summer Nuclear Station (VCS1/VCS2 switchyard), Jenkinsville, Fairfield County; published plant location

endpoint_notes.DESC:6367D: Riverport is a tap off the Jasper-Okatie corridor; the tap point is not public, so the project is placed on its host line with the line's uncertainty. Its uncertainty radius is set to half the 6.5-mile host line plus a margin (3.5 mi).
endpoint_notes.DESC:6853B-F: Scout is a customer substation; the description says the work modifies the VCS1 and Killian terminals.
